messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] package lifecontingencies released
messages.body_plain:
I've recently published on CRAN repository the  package lifecontingencies.
It appears to be the first R package to perform  lifecontingencies actuarial
present value evaluations. Suggestions and bug  reporting from those who
wish to try the package are welcome.

messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] R package cplm
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,

I have released another R package "cplm" that may be of special interest to the actuarial profession. This package focuses on estimation problems in common linear models with the Tweedie compound Poisson distribution. Currently, it implements Monte Carlo EM and Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods in generalized linear models, and in the next two months or so, I would add functions for estimating mixed-effect models with several frequentists' methods and one MCMC approach. In the meanwhile, I would appreciate any comments on the currently available functionality. Thanks.

P.S. The package can be downloaded either from CRAN or the project host:
http://code.google.com/p/cplm/


Regards,

Wayne (Yanwei) Zhang
